statusDetail: The audit host was geolocated to the United Kingdom and the origin returned HTTP 403 with a “Service unavailable in the United Kingdom” regulatory block page. The intended service, representative templates, and user flows were therefore unreachable.

page.notes: Only a static HTTP 403 regional denial page was observable. The underlying service architecture and templates could not be identified.

artifacts.caption: First viewport showing the United Kingdom regulatory access-denial page.
Rendered DOM and computed styles for the denial page; no navigation, links, forms, or service content were present.
Recon probe of internal links, metadata, forms, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml; both discovery endpoints returned the same 403 denial page.
HAR proving that the main document and favicon were denied with HTTP 403.
Compact network summary: two requests, both HTTP 403, with no reachable service resources.
Security-header probe of the 403 response. Retained as context only, not judged as representative of the unavailable service.
Raw-fetch/render comparison; the fetched response was HTTP 403 and contained only the denial notice.
Rendered browser view of the denial response.
Crawler view of the same denial response.
Atomic manifest of all 58 expected principle/check pairs and their planned evidence methods.
